page.layout: One column of running text, set full width. Below it a decorative woodcut ornament (fleuron), with no text. At the lower right, the catchword. Show-through from the reverse side in the right margin is not transcribed.

main_text.p: fuum, fuam hæreditatem, utque in his regionib. Ecclesiam sibi usque colligat, & à sordibus Antichristi purget; cœtus etiam docentium & discentium tueatur, ut in tranquillitate gloriam ejus evulgent & propagent, eorumque patronos tuetur omnes, inprimis Illustrissimum Principem & Electorem Palatinum FRIDERICUM I V. Dominum nostrum clementissimum, ejusque vitam, actiones, gubernationem & consilia suo spiritu gubernet, potentia sua & bonitate fortunet ac locupletet, ut universa cedant in laudem gloriosi nominis ejus, ac serviant multorum hominum æternæ saluti, per eundem Immanuelem Dominum nostrum, cui cum Patre & Spiritu sancto sit laus & gloria in æternum. Amen.

page.notes: The ornament below the text is a woodcut fleuron and carries no printed words. Show-through from the reverse side appears faintly in the right margin and was left out. The spacing in "FRIDERICUM I V." is as printed.
